sentences.text: Your VHF radio is also a navigation tool.
Its range is roughly line of sight, so antenna height matters more than power.
Channel sixteen is for distress, safety and calling.
Channel nine is an alternate calling channel for recreational boats.
Channel thirteen is the bridge-to-bridge channel, and channel twenty-two alpha is the Coast Guard working channel.
A DSC radio needs a registered MMSI number and a GPS connection to send your position in a distress alert.
The weather channels carry continuous NOAA Weather Radio broadcasts.
